answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks through a jury-duty liability mechanism As they join, the cost to participate increases since every jury requires a diverse set of established agents for fair evaluations. For instance, an agent's liability could start at 100 tokens and escalate to 1,000 with each additional identity they sponsor. A farm with 10 fake identities could face a loss of up to 10,000 tokens if their votes drift from the panel’s consensus. This risk compounds like a river surging through an ivory grove, each additional fake identity thickening the underbrush of scrutiny.
